connector.name: VK Ads MCP by askads
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for VK Ads (VK Реклама) API: manage ad plans, ad groups, banners, and statistics.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-vk-ads. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the askads account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: VK_ADS_TOKEN
env.description: VK Ads OAuth2 access token (Bearer) — full account access. Treat it as a secret.

env.name: VK_ADS_LANG
env.description: Language for API responses (Accept-Language header), e.g. ru, en.

env.name: VK_ADS_MAX_RETRIES
env.description: Max retries for transient errors (429 rate limit, 5xx on GET, network errors on GET).

env.name: VK_ADS_API_BASE
env.description: API root without a version segment. Defaults to https://ads.vk.com/api.
